senses.gloss: הִתְבִּיא (Tafel of בוא; cmp. מוּבָאת) to put into, fit, combine.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:10">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> (expl. <cite ref="V00045"><he>תביקין</he></cite>) <he>שהיו מַתְבִּיאוֹת בה</he> because with it they fitted (the timber, they used this cubit measure for buildings); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 53">Yalk. ib. 53</cite>. [The fem. gender in <he>מתביאות</he> may be accounted for by the frequent use of the mixed plural for mechanics, e.g. <he>גָּרוֹסוֹת</he>, <he>נְמוֹשׁוֹת</he>.]
